settings.broad_null: RNA-vector/lipid-vector independence across all 14 SD mice; sex structure may account for rejection
settings.broad_report_p: two-sided absolute coefficient-vector association tail with +1 correction
settings.conditional_null: RNA-vector/lipid-vector independence within each SD sex, retaining between-sex margins
settings.conditional_report_p: one-sided upper tail for positive reference alignment beyond shared sex structure, with +1 correction
settings.paired_bootstrap: paired SD mice within sex; paired reference mice within FCG group when available; stability only
settings.fixed_universe: observed eligible edges fixed before resampling; one undefined edge invalidates its summary vector
settings.inference_limit: conditional on fixed FCG reference and exchangeable mice; invalid-draw probabilities condition on valid draws; bootstrap size/power not calibrated
settings.centered_sensitivity: featurewise subtraction of each cohort's sex means, then Pearson; descriptive r/native ULM only on unchanged edge identities
settings.nominal_ULM: intercept OLS slope t and nominal p; dependent edges are not independent animals

interpretation: strict species annotation primary; conditional alias compatibility sensitivity; pooled replication and beyond-sex checks distinct
